blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Police authorities in Soccsksargen or Region 12 announced that eight persons have been arrested and 116 firearms surrendered or recovered during simultaneous law enforcement operations from Oct. 26 to Nov. 1. During the weeklong period, police conducted 109 operations against loose firearms, Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) director, said. Citing a consolidated accomplishment report, Manibog said the Cotabato Police Provincial Office recorded the highest number of operations at 40, resulting in six arrests and the surrender or recovery of 43 firearms.
